summary: This clinical trial compares the drug LY3457263 to a placebo (an inactive treatment) in people with type 2 diabetes. The study aims to measure changes in hemoglobin A1c, which is a blood test showing average blood sugar levels over time. Participants are adults aged 18 to 75 who are already taking certain stable doses of semaglutide or tirzepatide. Eli Lilly and Company is sponsoring this Phase 2 study with 200 participants, and the status is Recruiting.
